validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed independently of GEM, from two distinct organizational origins per the country brief's own convention (PNGRB counts as independent of GAIL). (1) PNGRB's regulator register: the current May-2026 line-wise NGPL MIS report (https://pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/20260531-NGPL-MIS-Report.pdf) lists, under OPERATIONAL COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE, entry #8 'Gujarat Regional Network', Entity GAIL, Authorisation Date 03.12.2010, Authorised Length 609 km, Authorised+Design Capacity 8.3 MMSCMD, Monthly Gas Supplied (May 2026) 3.0 MMSCMD, Capacity Utilisation 35%, Operating Length 585 km, states passing through 'GJ' (Gujarat) -- confirmed via pdftotext -layout since url_verifier's substring screen false-negatives on this PDF (see PDF note below). The archival 15-Jan-2016 PNGRB register (http://www.pngrb.gov.in/data-bank/NGPL-Operating-15012016.pdf, also downloaded + pdftotext'd directly) independently lists the SAME asset a decade earlier as entry #6 'Gujarat regional network (+RLNG+RIL)', 'GAIL (India) Limited', 608.8 km, 8.310 MMSCMD, authorised 03.12.2010 -- matching GEM's LengthKnown=608.82 km and Capacity=8.31 MMSCMD to two decimal places (closer than the current edition's rounded 609/8.3), and matching the authorisation date exactly. (2) A genuinely separate origin: GAIL's own PNGRB-filed engineering document, 'REPORT FOR CAPACITY ASSESSMENT [OF THE] INTEGRATED/INTERCONNECTED PIPELINE NETWORK' (https://pngrb.gov.in/pdf/public-notice/GAIL_Report_Annx_19042024.pdf, prepared by GAIL/EIL, not compiled by PNGRB staff) repeatedly names and describes the 'Gujarat Regional Pipeline'/'Gujarat Regional NGPL Network' as one of the constituent regional systems of GAIL's wider Integrated Network (its South Gujarat / Baroda sub-network specifically), confirming this is a real, GAIL-operated, named asset -- not a GEM-only or hallucinated entity. Combined, this is >=2 independent origins for existence -> high tier. CLASSIFICATION: 'transmission' is correct. PNGRB authorises this as a Section-42/Regulation-17 common-carrier NATURAL GAS pipeline (distinct from PNGRB's separately-licensed City Gas Distribution networks run by different entities in the same state, e.g. Adani/local CGDs) -- i.e. a trunk/transmission grid feeding industrial and CGD off-takers, matching the classification convention used consistently across every other GEM 'Regional Network'/'Grid' row in this roster (P0904, P0906, P0911, P0927, P0937, P0943), all of which are also PNGRB common-carrier NGPL entities. DUPLICATE CHECK vs the 35-row India-gas roster: NOT a duplicate. PNGRB lists 'Gujarat Regional Network' (GAIL, 609 km, entry #8), 'High Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' (GSPL, 2,860 km, entry #13) and 'Low Pressure Gujarat Gas Grid' (GSPL, 58 km, entry #15) as three SEPARATE authorised entities with different owners and non-overlapping lengths -- matching GEM's three separate rows P0923/P0927/P0937 exactly. No collapse recommended. ATTRIBUTION: Owner1='GAIL (India) Ltd' 100% is correct -- both PNGRB editions list Entity=GAIL for this exact asset, and GAIL's own capacity-assessment filing self-identifies this network as part of its own integrated system. Fuel=Gas is trivially correct. STATUS: 'operating' is correct -- the asset sits in PNGRB's 'OPERATIONAL COMMON CARRIER PIPELINE' table with a non-zero current operating length (585 km) and non-zero monthly gas supplied (3.0 MMSCMD, May 2026), i.e. actively flowing gas today, not merely authorised-but-idle. SPEC: LengthKnown 608.82 km and Capacity 8.31 MMSCMD match the 2016 PNGRB edition almost exactly (608.8 km / 8.310 MMSCMD) and the current 2026 edition after rounding (609 km / 8.3 MMSCMD) -- consistent with the country brief's documented CapacityBcm derivation pattern and with the sheet having been populated from an early-2020s PNGRB pull (wiki cites 'Retrieved 2023-07-13') that in this case happens to still match the current authorised figures (unlike some other rows in this roster where the authorised capacity has since changed). Note the LengthKnown figure GEM carries is the PNGRB AUTHORISED length (609 km), not the current PNGRB OPERATING length (585 km) -- both are legitimate PNGRB fields but they now differ by 24 km/~4%; flagging for awareness, not proposing a change, since 'authorised length' is the more stable, commonly-used figure across this roster's other rows. Only the length/capacity NUMBERS specifically trace to one origin type (PNGRB, at two vintages) rather than two -- GAIL's capacity-assessment filing confirms the network's identity/existence but does not restate its aggregate length or capacity, so treat the exact-decimal match as medium-tier corroboration even though existence/status/owner/classification clear high tier. PDF VERIFIER NOTE: url_verifier.py FAILs the content-substring check on all three PNGRB/GAIL PDFs cited here ('200 but missing expected') -- this is the documented large-PDF false negative for this project (PNGRB reports are large-format tables the extractor doesn't fully index). All three were downloaded directly and read with `pdftotext -layout`, and every quoted figure above was confirmed verbatim in the resulting text.

This is a regional grid, not a simple point-to-point line, so I am filling State/Province only (consistent with the sibling Gujarat grid rows P0927/P0937, which also leave StartLocation/EndLocation blank) rather than inventing specific start/end towns GEM does not already record.
